challenges.title: System Genesis: Root Protocol
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: Operative, the `<!DOCTYPE html>` protocol is the master handshake for all system architecture. It must be the first data packet in any transmission to ensure modern rendering protocols are engaged.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: System initialization has failed. The root protocol is missing from the primary document. Inject the `<!DOCTYPE html>` protocol at line 1 to begin.

challenges.title: Data Stream Error: Unclosed Packet
challenges.learningConcept:
[INTEL BRIEFING]: All data packets, like `

`, must be properly terminated with a closing sequence (e.g., `

`) to maintain stream integrity. Failure to terminate results in data corruption downstream.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: An unterminated paragraph packet is corrupting the data stream, causing layout instability. Locate and terminate the packet correctly by providing the full, corrected line.

challenges.title: Signal Corruption: Image Packet
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: Visual data packets (``) must include the `alt` protocol. This serves as a fallback for low-fidelity transmissions and is critical for our visually-impaired agents' access systems.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: A visual data packet has been flagged for non-compliance. The `alt` protocol is missing. Stabilize the packet by integrating the required `alt` attribute.

challenges.title: Architecture Anomaly: Generic Container
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: High-level system architecture requires semantic containers like `<header>` for proper indexing by our system crawlers. Generic containers (`<div>`) are inefficient and considered legacy.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: The page's primary header is using a generic container, causing a sub-optimal configuration alert. Upgrade the container to the `<header>` protocol.

challenges.title: Firewall Alert: Unspecified Target
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: To apply a security policy (CSS rule) to a group of elements (a class), the policy selector must be prefixed with the `.` designator to specify the target group.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: A firewall rule is failing to apply to the `error-text` class. The target designator is missing. Correct the selector to enforce the policy.

challenges.title: Security Breach: Unique Identifier
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: To apply a high-priority policy to a unique system component (an ID), the selector must be prefixed with the `#` hash designator for precise targeting.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: A critical policy is failing to engage on the `main-nav` component. The unique identifier is not being targeted. Fix the selector to secure the component.

challenges.title: Containment Field Failure
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: The `padding` protocol generates an internal buffer zone *inside* a container's forcefield (border). The `margin` protocol generates an external exclusion zone.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: The `.button` container's internal buffer has collapsed. It is incorrectly configured with an exclusion zone protocol. Replace `margin` with the correct `padding` protocol.

challenges.title: Vector Misalignment
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: In a `flex` vector field, the `justify-content` protocol governs alignment along the primary axis (horizontal by default).
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: Sub-components in the `.container` vector field are not aligning to the primary axis center. The wrong alignment protocol is engaged. Deploy `justify-content` to correct the vector.

challenges.title: Targeting Matrix: Gravitational Constant
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: The `text-align` property acts as a gravitational constant for text nodes within a container, aligning them horizontally.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: The text nodes in the `<h1>` container are misaligned. Select the correct protocol from the available options to apply a central gravitational pull.

challenges.title: Logic Bomb: Assignment vs. Comparison
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: In script execution, `=` is the assignment operator used to implant a value. `===` is the comparison operator used to verify a value. Confusing them can lead to catastrophic logic failures.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: A conditional statement contains a logic bomb. It's assigning a value instead of comparing it. Disarm the bomb by correcting the operator to `===`.

challenges.title: Subroutine Malfunction
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: To execute a named subroutine (a function), you must use the invocation operator `()`. Simply referencing the name will not trigger execution.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: The `showWelcomeMessage` subroutine is failing to execute because the invocation operator is missing. Trigger the subroutine correctly.

challenges.title: Interface Anomaly: Null Pointer
challenges.learningConcept: [INTEL BRIEFING]: The `querySelector` utility requires a valid CSS selector string to interface with the Document Object Matrix (DOM). For unique IDs, this requires the `#` prefix.
challenges.description: [MISSION OBJECTIVE]: A query for the `main-title` interface component is returning a null pointer. The selector is invalid. Correct the query string to establish a connection.
